name: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – Davao Leg 3
short_description: A half-marathon-anchored race at Azuela Cove, Davao City, Philippines, held on September 27, 2026, organized by Runrio.
ai_summary: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – Davao Leg 3 is a road race scheduled for September 27, 2026, at Azuela Cove in Davao City, Philippines. Organized by Runrio under the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia brand, the event offers multiple distances including 32km, 21.1km (the primary half-marathon distance), 10km, and 5km. research_highlights: The Davao leg has used a consistent out-and-back course at Ayala Azuela Cove in Lanang since the series began in 2024.
Leg 3 in Davao (the September date) features 5K, 10K, 21K, and a 32K 'Afroman' distance as its centerpiece race.
Completing the progressive distances across a city's three legs (16K in Leg 1, 21K in Leg 2, 32K in Leg 3) qualifies runners for the 42K category at the November National Finals in Pasay.
The race is organized by RunRio Inc. with KinetixSports as the local Davao partner, and recent Davao legs have drawn crowds in the range of roughly 2,700 to 3,800 runners across categories.
research_watchouts: No participant race reviews were found on race-review platforms (e.g., Let's Do This listings for both the 2025 Leg 1 and Leg 3 Davao editions explicitly show no reviews submitted), so independent, first-hand runner feedback on course conditions or organization is scarce online.

Available public coverage of this race is dominated by results-focused sports journalism (finish times and podium names) rather than descriptive race reports, so details on things like crowd support, aid stations, or heat management during the actual run are not well documented in what's publicly available.

faqs.question: When is the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – Davao Leg 3?
faqs.answer: The race is scheduled to take place on September 27, 2026. It will be held at Azuela Cove in Davao City, Philippines. This date marks the third leg of the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia series for that year.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The event offers four distance categories: 32km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. The 21.1km half-marathon distance is considered the primary distance for this race, giving participants a range of options depending on their fitness level and racing goals.

faqs.question: Who organizes this race?
faqs.answer: The race is organized by Runrio, operating under the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia brand. Runrio is responsible for organizing this leg of the trilogy series, which takes place in Davao City, Philippines, as part of a broader multi-leg race event.

faqs.question: Is registration open yet?
faqs.answer: As of now, the registration status for this race has not yet been announced. Interested participants will need to watch for further updates from the organizer, Runrio, regarding when and how to sign up for the Davao Leg 3 event.
